listings.why: Exact character brief: irregular masonry, terracotta, wooden shutters, exposed wood inside, private pool and BBQ on 15,500 m² between Porreres and Felanitx, plus a holiday-rental license and energy A. Ready, secluded, not a contemporary box.
listings.note: Opened 31 Aug 2026. Page price € 998.000. Ref 27563 (expose 848187). Stats row 15.500 / 200 / 3 / 2; body also says living area approx. 116 m². Own well + mains water/electric, A/C, automatic gates. Village/country-with-pool at nearly €1M is not a bargain vs Sant Joan €690k / Son Negre €730k — bargain false.

listings.name: Llucmajor natural-stone finca with saltwater pool
listings.headline: Natural-stone finca, 35 m² saltwater pool, pellet stove, PV, 7,100 m² — €1.198M
listings.why: Design-forward south finca: golden masonry, bougainvillea porch, 35 m² saltwater pool, outdoor kitchen and fireplace, underfloor heating and pellet stove. Character brief met; price sits at the €1.2M cap so not a bargain.
listings.note: Opened 31 Aug 2026. Offer 1198000 EUR; page InStock. Construction year 2002. 3 bed / 2 bath / 197 m² on 7,100 m² (third room listed as dressing/office). PV + grid, modern septic. Not reserved. At-cap — bargain false.

listings.name: Ostuni trullo + lamia
listings.headline: Original trullo plus extended lamia, private pool on 6,500 m² of olives — €320k
listings.why: Habitable old-and-new at a punch-above price: living in the trullo, kitchen + bedroom + two baths in the lamia, built private pool, flat olive plot. €320k is far under typical restored-with-pool Ostuni countryside.
listings.note: Only 2 beds / 109 m². Schema Offer €320000 InStock. Energy class D. Year listed 1920.

listings.name: Plemmirio charming pool villa
listings.headline: 2018-renovated 3-bed villa, private pool, 100 m from the Plemmirio sea — €450k
listings.why: Habitable now with a built private pool, masonry outdoor kitchen and wood oven, and a 2018 full redo — €450k is cheap for a 3-bed in the Plemmirio reserve. Cozy two-building layout, not a sleek box.
listings.note: Opened 29 Aug 2026. Schema Offer €450000. 3 bed / 2 bath / ~130 m² / ~1,000 m². Two buildings linked by a veranda; 3 kW PV; two hot outdoor showers; already in short-let. Features include Swimming pool. Not the board’s isola-siracusa.

listings.name: Selinunte olive villa
listings.headline: 2011 west-Sicily house with a 12×6 salt pool and about 2 ha of olives
listings.why: Sicily outside Avola/Noto. Recent house, all bedrooms en suite, 12×6 salt pool, and a second building for garage or studio.
listings.note: Lowest price on this pass. Still a current E&V luxury-desk listing, not a fixer. PV predisposed, not stated as installed.

listings.name: Felanitx porch-pool farmhouse
listings.headline: 193 m² farmhouse, fireplace, large porch to private pool on 2,848 m² — €480k
listings.why: Country with private pool at €480k — well under the bargain band. Fireplace living room opens to a big porch and pool; 3 beds (one en-suite with dressing room), furnished kitchen, 3 min from Felanitx. Punches hard vs island village/country-with-pool stock.
listings.note: Opened 30 Aug 2026. Page price 480.000 Eur ON SALE (also on mallorcasol.com). Ref 12088. Metered water; electricity via solar panels. Habitable/furnished as listed — not a fixer shell. Not the board's felanitx W-047MW6 or felanitx-historic 5237.

listings.name: Costitx courtyard house
listings.headline: 1800 village house, 2020 redo, private saltwater patio pool, rooftop to the Tramuntana
listings.why: The brief at a Mallorca price that is usually Italy: 1800 fabric, 2020 design redo, micro-cement, outdoor kitchen, real saltwater patio pool, rooftop to the mountains. Asking €489k — well below inland design-with-pool stock on this island.
listings.note: Tiny 86 m² plot and only one bath. ev-mallorca JSON-LD Offer InStock €489000. Energy class E. Some gallery stills are PNG.

listings.name: Villa Corten
listings.headline: Corten, Lecce stone, infinity pool facing Pescoluse
listings.why: New 2024 architecture in stone and corten, with a 30 sqm infinity pool aimed at the Pescoluse horizon.
listings.note: Smallest house on the board. One bedroom. Strongest design per euro.

listings.name: Ses Salines single-floor pool house
listings.headline: Move-in village house, private patio pool, all on one floor — €490k
listings.why: Private pool inside Ses Salines village at €490k — the agency FAQ states exclusive private use, not communal. Single-floor, ready, walk-to-everything. Cheapest true village-with-private-pool punch on the island next to Costitx (€489k).
listings.note: Opened 29 Aug 2026. Page price 490.000€ For sale. Property ID 1348. 2 bed / 1 bath / 110 m² on 170 m² plot, energy D, A/C hot-cold, BBQ terrace. Not the board's ses-salines 1441 / ses-salines-row 1487 / ses-salines-lane 1504.

listings.name: Poggio Alta Vista, Ponibbiale
listings.headline: 2024-redone stone casale, private pool, Trasimeno view, Piegaro 3 km / Panicale 11 km
listings.pool: Private pool with solarium (built, not a project)
listings.agency: Engel & Völkers Perugia (also Antonini & Partners as Poggio Alta Vista)
listings.why: The only sub-€600k habitable stone house with a built private pool on this hunt. 2024 redo, terracotta and stone fireplaces, 1.3 ha, Trasimeno in the view. Marketed by Antonini as next to Panicale (Piegaro 3 km, Panicale 11 km).
listings.note: E&V JSON-LD Offer InStock €525000, datePosted 2025-07-17, Ponibbiale hamlet of Piegaro, 8 rooms / 5 beds / 4 baths / ~270 m² / ~13,000 m², energy F, year 1980. Antonini page opened today as Casale Poggio Alta Vista, same €525.000, 300 m², 4 official beds + 2 attic rooms, year 1985, last renovation 2024, energy G, property id 70461 / 71308: https://www.antoniniepartners.com/estate_property/casale-poggio-alta-vista/ — treat as one house, two desks.

listings.name: Nizza Monferrato vaulted pool villa
listings.headline: Independent cascina, brick vaults, stone-pillar porches and a private pool in the Nizza vines — €525k
listings.why: Habitable now with a built private pool, brick-vaulted ground floor and wood-vaulted porches on stone pillars — old Monferrato cascina, not a sleek box. €525k for ~455 m² in the Nizza DOCG vines punches well above typical Piedmont-with-pool.
listings.note: Opened 30 Aug 2026. Schema Offer €525000 InStock. Overview: 7 bed / 5 bath / 455 m² / 2,940 m². 45 m² pergola, arched windows, double kitchen, hayloft master with vineyard views. Independent (not the board’s mombaruzzo-pool CP-1683 or morsasco CP-1749). Tags include Swimming pool.

listings.name: Casa del Colle, Penne
listings.headline: Contemporary villa with a 6×14 salt pool and views to Lago di Penne and Gran Sasso
listings.why: Abruzzo is new on the board. Furnished contemporary house, large salt pool, long views. Not a rustico.
listings.note: Sold furnished. 34 olive trees. Last Casa.it update 30 Jul 2026.

listings.name: Trullo and lamia, Ostuni
listings.headline: Restored trullo plus lamia, 10×4 private pool on 1.2 ha of olives, minutes from the White City
listings.pool: Private 10×4 m pool, solarium and BBQ
listings.why: Habitable trullo and lamia, exposed local stone and vaults, built 10×4 pool, 12,000 m² of olives. €545k is well under typical restored-with-pool Ostuni countryside.
listings.note: Only 100 m² interior. Page says good condition, A/C, alarm, satellite wifi. English URL served a French template today; price and specs are on the page as € 545.000.

listings.name: Villa Paradise, Avola
listings.headline: Ready Sicilian-style villa, private pool, 8,000 m² of olives, sea view
listings.why: Finished Mediterranean house with PV and a built pool. New local-agent stock.
listings.note: Only two bedrooms.

listings.name: Glass woodland villa
listings.headline: Wall of glass in 3 hectares of private forest
listings.why: Multi-storey quadruple-glazed glass façade and a sculptural iron stair. Architecture, not a rustico.
listings.note: Huge house and land for the price. Pool and some interiors still to finish.

listings.name: Nocciano villa
listings.headline: 2012 contemporary house with a 12 m salt pool, marble kitchen, 15 minutes from Pescara
listings.why: Abruzzo contemporary with an existing salt pool, Carrara kitchen, underfloor heating and solar.
listings.note: Page last updated 27 Apr 2025. Confirm exclusivity before you travel.

listings.name: Agliano Terme restored vineyard cascina
listings.headline: Walk-to-village restored cascina, exposed brick, magnificent private pool, own vines — €575k reduced
listings.why: Arrive-with-a-suitcase restore: exposed-brick dining room, former stables as a stove lounge, wine cellar and a magnificent built swimming pool in the Barbera vines. Reduced to €575k — restored-with-pool under the ~€750k bargain line, walkable to the village.
listings.note: Opened 30 Aug 2026. Schema Offer €575000 Reducedprice. Overview: 4 bed / 2 bath / 336 m² / 3,500 m² (lot 670). Energy D. Tag: Swimming pool. Body: ‘completed by a magnificent swimming pool’. Semi-detached tag; courtyard stables/hayloft only partially renovated (main house ready). Not Mombaruzzo CP-1683.

listings.name: Moscari terrace house
listings.headline: 2023-updated Moscari rowhouse, private garden pool, Tramuntana views
listings.why: A private pool and mountain edge at €580k on Mallorca is the cut. 2023 update, open living to terrace, garden and pool, solar, furnished.
listings.note: Rowhouse, not detached. Card says 2008; copy also says built 2006. Energy class C. Not Reserved on the page today.

listings.name: Es Mercadal forest country house
listings.headline: Charming 3-bed Menorcan country house, private pool, hidden in woods on 2,000 m² — €585k
listings.why: Named boutique agency, ready country house with a built private pool, forest privacy, 190 m² on ~2,000 m². €585k is well under the island’s usual €900k–€1.2M private-pool band.
listings.note: Opened 29 Aug 2026. Page: 190 m² / 2.000 m² / 3 beds / 1 bath / 585.000€, energy D. Copy: ‘escondida entre la tranquilidad del bosque… tres dormitorios, piscina privada’. Not a fixer line. Only one bathroom — flag it. Not rustic-wreck; habitable character hideaway. Not 5678 (Ciutadella finca) and not 5682 Son Remei already on the board.

listings.name: Stone casale, Città di Castello
listings.headline: 1885 Umbrian stone farmhouse, interiors left in pietra, recently redone pool, 4 km from Tuscany
listings.pool: Recently renovated private pool, stone bath and covered shower
listings.why: Exposed stone inside and out, two-level plan that can split into two units, real pool already rebuilt, olives, €589k. Umbria outside Foligno and Trasimeno.
listings.note: E&V statusNormalized ACTIVE, JSON-LD Offer €589000. Posted 4 Aug 2026. Energy class G. Gas radiators. Different house from Trasimeno and Perugia already on the board.

listings.name: Carovigno stone-vault villa
listings.headline: Fully renovated stone-vault house, 2 beds, private pool on 1.7 ha olives near Carovigno
listings.why: Recovered pietra vaults, always used as a private home, big olive land, built pool, town and sea a few minutes away. €590k for 190 m² + 17,100 m² land punches above.
listings.note: Only 2 bedrooms. Schema Offer €590000. Page stresses full renovation and year-round use.

listings.name: Casa le Bizze
listings.headline: 2008 Casentino villa with a salt infinity pool, wellness basement and olive garden
listings.why: Inland Tuscany that is not Versilia or Chioma. Contemporary-elegant 2008 house with a real infinity pool.
listings.note: Energy class G. 4 kW solar. Basement gym and tavern. Not the no-pool Corten tower nearby.

listings.name: Stone casale, Castel del Piano
listings.headline: Tuscan stone farmhouse, 2 ha of olives, private pool facing Montegiovi
listings.pool: Private pool in front of the house
listings.why: Exposed stone, habitable now, real pool. Amiata is new on the board.
listings.note: Wood and solar heating. 3 km from town.

listings.name: Son Bou contemporary
listings.headline: Compact contemporary house with designer kitchen, salt pool and rooftop solarium
listings.why: Clean contemporary architecture, designer kitchen, salt pool and rooftop solarium with sea views. Strongest design under €600k on the island today.
listings.note: Tiny interior: 74 sqm / 2 beds on 432 sqm. Boutique, not a family villa. Energy class E.

listings.name: Arenella Modica-stone pool villa
listings.headline: 3-bed villa, fireplace, masonry kitchen, 16×8 Modica-stone pool, 1 km from Arenella beach — €590k
listings.why: Built 16×8 private pool edged in Modica stone, masonry kitchen, fireplace living room and fruit trees — cozy Sicily, not a glass box. €590k and 1 km from Arenella beach is cheap for a habitable 3-bed with a serious pool.
listings.note: Opened 30 Aug 2026. Schema Offer €590000. Features hasSwimmingPool true. 3 bed / 2 bath / 165 m² internal (210 total) / 3,500 m² plot (2,500 garden + 1,000 extra with residual cubage). Covered verandas, BBQ. Not the board’s plemmirio-charme W-048J0F or isola-siracusa W-047176.

listings.name: Cala Blanca immaculate pool chalet
listings.headline: Immaculate ready 3-bed chalet, garden and private pool in Cala Blanca — €590k
listings.why: Ready-now west-coast chalet: immaculate, AC living room, garden + patio + private pool + garage. €590k punches far under Menorca’s usual €900k–€1.2M private-pool band — and under the board’s other Cala Blanca at €905k.
listings.note: Opened 30 Aug 2026. Asking 590.000 € (current). 3 bed / 2 bath + guest toilet / 118 m² / 432 m². Copy: garden, patio, terrace and swimming pool; ‘ready to enjoy without the need for further improvements’. Yesterday’s HELD overflow (strong bargain) — taken today because it still clearly beats new mid-band finds. Not board cala-blanca 36684 (€905k).

listings.name: Canneto stone houses
listings.headline: Restored Ligurian village houses with exposed rock, garden pool and sea view
listings.why: Two hamlet houses built into the rock, restored, stone fireplace, private garden pool, sea view from the roof.
listings.note: 370 m² plot. Parking is public, about 50 m away. 20 minutes to Imperia beaches.

listings.name: Foligno contemporary
listings.headline: Single-level 2020 house with Vimar home automation
listings.why: Purpose-built contemporary, full-height glass to the garden, A4 fabric, full home automation.
listings.note: Confirm the live asking price. It has been syndicated at different figures.

listings.name: Trebalúger garden villa
listings.headline: Trebaluger villa — price now “Consultar” (was €597k); still live with private pool
listings.pool: Private pool off a covered terrace
listings.why: Detached Menorca house with a built pool under €600k. Five minutes to Es Castell and Sant Lluís. Not the €1.195M Trebalúger already on the board.
listings.note: Title “Comprar:”, on-page Precio: 597.000 €. High ceilings, electric radiators, A/C pre-install. More cozy Mediterranean than cubist. Guest toilet on the ground floor in addition to the two baths. As of 28 Aug 2026 Bonnin shows Precio: Consultar (597k no longer published); listing still live with photos.

listings.name: Punta Prima pool house
listings.headline: 2020-reformed adosada, private pool, sea and Illa de l’Aire, cut from €640k to €599k
listings.why: Visible price drop on the ficha (640 → 599). 2020 interiors, exposed-stone terrace pillar, built private pool, sea from the upper terrace. Small house that punches above the number, a short walk from the beach.
listings.note: Semi-detached. Title remains “Comprar:”. Copy says ready to live in or keep renting. Confirm the tourist licence on a call.

listings.name: Mombaruzzo vineyard pool villa
listings.headline: 3-bed villa, saltwater pool and veranda in the Monferrato vines — €625k
listings.why: Saltwater pool, openable veranda, wine cellar and 6 kW PV (2021) in the vines of Mombaruzzo. €625k for 265 m² with a built private pool punches above typical Piedmont-with-pool, and it is habitable year-round.
listings.note: Opened 29 Aug 2026. Schema Offer €625000 InStock. 3 bed / 3 bath / 265 m² / 1,316 m². Three levels: basement cellar+gym, ground living+veranda to the pool, first-floor 3 beds. Alarm app, double garage. Not the board’s morsasco CP-1749.

listings.name: San Briccio villa
listings.headline: Full 2023 A4 renovation with pool and in-house spa, Verona hills
listings.why: Contemporary interiors, A4 kit, actual pool. East of Verona, not Garda. Basement spa with sauna and whirlpool.
listings.note: Two bedrooms only. PV, hybrid heat pump, EV charger.

listings.name: Son Bou townhouse with private pool
listings.headline: Ready 3-bed townhouse, private pool, panoramic Bay of Son Bou views — €630k
listings.why: Walk-to-Son-Bou-beach townhouse, impeccable and ready, built private pool + BBQ + covered terrace with bay views. €630k punches well under typical Menorca-with-private-pool.
listings.note: Opened 29 Aug 2026. Schema Offer €630000. 3 beds (2 double + 1 single) / 2 baths / 119 m² / 315 m². Year 1989. Exclusive listing. Copy: ‘beautiful private swimming pool… ready to move into’. Features: AC, garden, sea view, furnished. Address locality Torre Solí; title markets it as Son Bou. Not son-bou (W-049WWL €1.2M) or son-bou-newbuild (W-047YU3).

listings.name: Son Parc single-storey chalet
listings.headline: One-level 3-bed chalet, private pool and garden, walk from golf and beach — €635k
listings.why: Detached, habitable, one floor, fireplace living room, private pool + garden + garage in Son Parc. €635k is a genuine Menorca-with-private-pool bargain versus the island's usual €900k–€1.2M band.
listings.note: Opened 28 Aug 2026. Exclusive. Page: 3 bed / 2 bath / 149 m² / 705 m² plot. Independent kitchen, good orientation. Not a fixer — description presents it as ready for year-round or holiday use.

listings.name: Trullo da Sogno, Cisternino
listings.headline: 1810 trulli and lamia, restored, panoramic pool on 2 ha of olives
listings.why: Historic trulli plus autonomous lamia, restored, built pool, 2 ha of olives.
listings.note: Energy class G. Two kitchens.

listings.name: Cala Llonga Mediterranean pool villa
listings.headline: Charming 3-bed villa, renovated kitchen, private pool and sea views — cut to €650k
listings.why: Peaceful Cala Llonga, private pool, sea views, bespoke renovated kitchen, three doubles + two baths, garage. Cut from €700k to €650k — a genuine bargain versus the board’s other Cala Llonga villas at €890k–€915k.
listings.note: Opened 29 Aug 2026. Current asking 650.000 € (antes 700.000 € — use current). Icons: 3 bed / 2 bath / Pool / Views / AC / Garden / Garage / 122 m² construidos / 573 m² solar. Copy also says 547 m² plot. Not cala-llonga W-02Q9ZO, cala-llonga-new MEN58405, or cala-llonga-obra 93476.

listings.name: Garlenda country villa with pool
listings.headline: Stone-porch country villa, olives, fenced private pool, 10 min from Alassio — €650k
listings.why: Old-and-new Liguria: fireplace living room, two stone porches, centuries-old olives and a fenced medium pool with solar outdoor shower. €650k restored-with-pool under the ~€750k bargain line, 10 minutes from Alassio beaches.
listings.note: Opened 29 Aug 2026. Schema Offer €650000. 3 bed / 2 bath / ~200 m² / ~990 m². Ground bed+bath; attic two beds + study + bath + terrace; garage connected. Features include Swimming pool. Energy D. Not Andora / Diano / Porto Maurizio already on the board.

listings.name: Villa Mari
listings.headline: Concept villa with infinity pool near the beach
listings.why: Clean contemporary volumes, floor-to-ceiling sliders, scenic infinity pool about 600 m from the sea.
listings.note: Still finishing. Some photos are project imagery. Confirm what €650k includes.

listings.name: Noto Falconara pool villa
listings.headline: 2022-renovated 4-bed villa, private 4×8 pool, 2 km from Noto — €650k
listings.why: Habitable now, energy A+, private 4×8 pool and masonry outdoor kitchen between Noto centro and the beaches. €650k for a 2022 redo with 4/4 is cheap for this pocket of Sicily.
listings.note: Opened 28 Aug 2026. Page: 155 m² on ~400 m² garden, 6 kW PV + 6 kWh storage, certificato di agibilità, already in tourist rentals 12+ years. Two levels: living + 2 baths down, 4 beds + 2 baths up.

listings.name: Villa Certosa
listings.headline: Bright Ostuni countryside villa, brick-and-timber veranda, private 4×8 pool on 4,700 m²
listings.why: Design-leaning outdoor life (veranda + 4×8 pool) at €650k with artesian well, alarm, A/C — under typical for habitable pool villas around Ostuni.
listings.note: Agency rif 11523 / internal 24491. Page: Ottime condizioni, energy G. Interior only ~100 m².

listings.name: La Trinità, Perugia
listings.headline: Recent hillside villa with an infinity pool and four ensuite bedrooms
listings.why: Umbria outside Foligno and Trasimeno. Open living onto an infinity pool, four ensuite bedrooms, independent guest apartment.
listings.note: Energy class B. Underfloor heating, A/C, five parking spaces. English luxury URL 404'd; this Cortesi page is live.

listings.name: Sineu stone country house
listings.headline: 304 m² country house, stone fireplace, timber ceilings, private pool on 5,400 m² — €650k
listings.why: Old-and-new Mallorca: thick stone walls, timber-beamed bedrooms, stone fireplace, private pool and BBQ on a big plot under 1 km from Sineu centre. €650k for 304 m² + 5,400 m² land is a clear bargain vs island village/country-with-pool stock.
listings.note: Opened 29 Aug 2026. Page price 650.000€ For sale. Property ID 1466. 4 bed / 2 bath / 304 m², land 5.400 m², garage, A/C + central heating, energy D, unfurnished. Interior Pla — east-coast beaches ~25–30 min.

listings.name: Sa Roca countryside villa with pool
listings.headline: Charming 3-bed countryside house, private pool and fruit trees on 3,341 m² — €655k
listings.why: Authenticity over sleek: open kitchen, fireplace, central heating, garden with built private pool and fruit trees on ~3,341 m². €655k is well under the island’s private-pool band.
listings.note: Opened 30 Aug 2026. Offer.price €655000. 3/2 / ~168 m² / ~3,341 m². Breadcrumb locality Sa Roca; Ciutadella shop. Copy: ‘beautiful swimming pool, fruit trees… unique home to recharge’. i18n ‘no longer available’ ignored. Not on board. Not a fixer line.

listings.name: Panoramic trullo villa, Valle d’Itria
listings.headline: 4-bed villa with trullo, valley-facing private pool, 1.5+ ha olives between Ceglie and Martina
listings.location: Between Ceglie Messapica and Martina Franca
listings.why: Big ready house with trullo character, 4/4, panoramic pool, 15,650 m² planted land at €670k — strong size-for-price in the Itria Valley.
listings.note: Schema Offer €670000. EN page confirms swimming pool facing the valley. Not the board’s existing Ostuni W-03023F (€670k contemporary).

listings.name: Ostuni 2024 contemporary
listings.headline: 2024 villa with barrel vaults, private pool and 7,730 m² of olives between Ostuni and Carovigno
listings.pool: Private pool; outdoor tub by the master suite
listings.why: New 2024 house, barrel vaults, three bedrooms opening to the garden, private pool, olive land. Cheaper newer alternative to the Ostuni trullo.
listings.note: English page says 180 m² commercial; Italian page ~209 m². Energy class F — confirm APE. Published 18 Jun 2026.

listings.name: Gravedona lake villas
listings.headline: Minimalist hillside pair with private pools
listings.why: Floor-to-ceiling glass, exposed concrete, quartz-resin floors, gold steel. Each unit has its own pool.
listings.note: Semi-detached, not standalone. Interiors still customisable. New-build VAT may apply.

listings.name: Trullo La Specchia
listings.headline: Two-century trullo plus lamia, 4 beds, salt pool in olives — €680k
listings.why: Old-and-new in one: original trullo plus newer wing, antique-furnished, salt-electrolysis pool, pergolas, fenced olive park. Energy A+. €680k is well under typical restored-with-pool Valle d'Itria.
listings.note: Opened 28 Aug 2026. Schema Offer €680000. 4 beds / 3 baths / ~140 m² / ~5,538 m². Two beds + two baths in the newer part; two beds + one bath in the trullo. Furnished. Agency is E&V Salento Lecce, not Ostuni.

listings.name: Ses Salines lane townhouse
listings.headline: Quiet-street 3-bed townhouse with a truly private patio pool — €680k
listings.why: Village house with a private rear-patio pool — the listing itself calls that a rarity in Ses Salines. Walk-to-everything, garage, A/C + heating, minutes from Es Trenc. €680k punches above the Mallorca village-with-private-pool set (board already has Ses Salines new-builds near €1.19M).
listings.note: Opened 28 Aug 2026. Page price 680.000€. 3 bed / 2 bath / 146 m², built 2007, unfurnished, year-round kit. Not the board's existing ses-salines / ses-salines-row new-builds.

listings.name: Green Luxury NZEB
listings.headline: Energy-positive villa in Desenzano’s Piccola Toscana
listings.why: Tailor-made A4 NZEB villa with triple glazing, underfloor heat/cool, and a private pool in a gated vineyard setting.
listings.note: Off-plan in a multi-villa resort. Photos include renders.

listings.name: Sant Joan finca with pool and views
listings.headline: 1990/2020 finca, guest apartment, pool renovated 2022 on 1.35 ha — €690k
listings.agency: Engel & Völkers Santa Maria / EV Mallorca
listings.why: Quiet Sant Joan (Petra/Sineu belt) finca with private pool renovated 2022, outdoor kitchen, fireplace, olive/lemon trees, solar + own well. €690k for 219 m² + 1.35 ha is a clear bargain vs Pla country-with-pool comps.
listings.note: Opened 30 Aug 2026. Offer 690000 EUR; page InStock. 3 bed / 2 bath (main house + separate apartment bath). Listing notes registration with authorities still in process (architects supporting) — legal check needed; presented as structurally up-to-date and lived-in. Not on prior board.

listings.name: Fenegrò A4 villa
listings.headline: 2025 gas-free designer house with pool, oak floors and stone bathrooms
listings.why: Clean contemporary new-build with a real pool and A4 kit. Turnkey north Italy while lake stock under €1.2M is mostly 1970s.
listings.note: Not lakefront. Small garden waiting to be planted. Double garage. Heat pump, PV, VMC.

listings.name: Llubí plunge-pool townhouse
listings.headline: 1900s townhouse, stone + beams, 3 en-suites, private plunge pool — €695k
listings.agency: Engel & Völkers Santa Maria / EV Mallorca
listings.why: Character interior (stone wall, wood-beamed ceiling) mixed with ducted A/C and heat-pump underfloor heating. Private terrace plunge pool, three en-suite bedrooms, ready. €695k undercuts the board's other Llubí (llubi-garden €890k) and most village-with-pool comps.
listings.note: Opened 29 Aug 2026. Offer price 695000 EUR; page InStock; status ACTIVE. 3 bed / 3 bath / 120 m² on 90 m² plot. Not W-02T58J. Plunge pool is private (not communal).

listings.name: Cala Llonga harbour-view pool chalet
listings.headline: 2-storey chalet with private pool and Port of Mahón views — €695k
listings.why: Named boutique agency. Harbour views are the hero; terrace with built private pool; garage for a boat. 256 m² — serious space at €695k vs other Cala Llonga board cards at €890k–€915k.
listings.note: Opened 30 Aug 2026. Icons 256 m² / 4 / 3 / 695.000€. Copy: 3 dormitorios + habitación adicional, 2 baños + aseo, terraza con piscina, vistas al puerto de Mahón, amplio garaje. Yesterday held to avoid doubling Cala Llonga (keeper then was Bonnin 93327 €650k) — taken today as a distinct Ses Moreres card still not on the board. Not cala-llonga-93327, W-02Q9ZO, MEN58405, or cala-llonga-obra 93476.

listings.name: Villa Aura
listings.headline: Turnkey modern house with sea view near Noto
listings.why: Finished contemporary villa on 1.15 hectares, anti-seismic, open living to the view, a few minutes from Noto and the Vendicari coast.
listings.note: No pool in the listing. Sea view and a lot of land at €700k.

listings.name: Ostuni Foragno infinity villa
listings.headline: Restored 3-bed villa + annex, panoramic infinity pool, 6,200 m² olives — €700k
listings.why: Built panoramic infinity pool looking over the Ostuni countryside, two patios, a climate-controlled patio, and a guest annex — habitable now. €700k with a private infinity pool is well under typical restored-with-pool Valle d’Itria.
listings.note: Opened 29 Aug 2026. Page price 700000 €. 2 beds in the main body + 1 in the dependance / 3 baths / 90 m² main / 6,200 m² fenced olives and fruit. Underfloor heating, A/C, alarm, automatic gate. Energy B. 6 km from Ostuni centro, 12 km from the coast. Photos dated 4 Aug 2026 on the live gallery.

listings.name: Donnagnora lamia + trullo
listings.headline: Restored lamia and Saracen trullo, 3 suites, private pool on 1.1 ha — €715k
listings.why: Stone, vaults, original materials kept; lamia living + two ensuite doubles; trullo as its own suite. Built pool, pergola, olives and macchia. Ready, no works flagged.
listings.note: Opened 28 Aug 2026. Schema Offer €715000 InStock. Features: A/C, alarm, pool, fireplace, jacuzzi. Energy cert in progress. Stone floors. Page lists ~205 m² (EN card also showed ~191 m²).

listings.name: Mahón patio house, 1890s
listings.headline: Late-19th-century Mahón house, fully reformed 2019, hydraulic tiles and a private pool
listings.pool: Private pool in the patio garden
listings.why: Old-and-new: beams, hydraulic tiles, modern systems, and a real pool a few minutes from the centre.
listings.note: Small 147 m² plot. Third bedroom is a semi-basement studio.

listings.name: Ses Salines town house
listings.headline: 2025 contemporary town house with a private garden, pool and garage
listings.why: Move-in 2025 new-build in the village core: private garden, usable pool, garage. Open-plan ground floor to the terrace.
listings.note: Small development, each unit has its own pool. Energy class B. Not a communal-pool scheme.

listings.name: Francavilla Fontana Trullo Armonia
listings.headline: Authentic trullo, 4 beds, private pool, PV, Itria–Salento crossroads — €728k
listings.why: A real trullo, not a new white box: four bedrooms (two ensuite), private swimming pool as the outdoor centrepiece, photovoltaic, habitable now (building status GOOD). €728k restored-with-pool sits under the ~€750k bargain line.
listings.note: Opened 30 Aug 2026. Page price €728.000. Features: Energy G, GOOD CONDITION, 160 m², 8 rooms, 4 bed / 3 bath, Swimming Pool SI. 17 km Brindisi airport, 20 km sea. Not OS551/OS563/SV570/SV592 already on the board. Land area not stated on the card.

listings.name: Son Negre rustic finca with pool
listings.headline: 1920 Son Negre finca, cédula, private pool + BBQ, 21,849 m² — €729.9k
listings.why: Authentic Felanitx/Son Negre rural character: 1920 house with two chimneys, private pool with BBQ and bath, fruit trees, annexes, well — and a cédula de habitabilidad. €729.9k on nearly 22k m² punches above for southeast country-with-pool.
listings.note: Opened 30 Aug 2026. Page price 729.900€ (updated 13 Aug 2026). Main dwelling ~136 m²; listing dimensions also show 450 m² including annexes. Energy G. Habitable certificate stated. Minutes from Felanitx / Cas Concos. Not board felanitx / felanitx-historic.

listings.name: Todi 18th-c stone casali with pool
listings.headline: Two stone farmhouses + annex, exposed beams and cotto, 5×12 private pool, view of Todi — €730k
listings.location: Hills a few kilometres from Todi
listings.why: The character brief in stone: 18th-century walls, exposed beams, terracotta, stone fireplaces, olives/oaks/cypress and a built 5×12 pool. Two independent houses plus a 30 m² annex, roofs newly insulated — habitable now. €730k for 390 m² is a restored-with-pool bargain.
listings.note: Opened 30 Aug 2026. Schema Offer €730000. Features hasSwimmingPool true. 5 bed / 4 bath / 390 m² / 6,800 m². Main house kitchen+living+terrace; second one-level house 3 bed/3 bath; annex with bath+A/C. Not umbertide-casale W-046MC7 or panicale listings.

listings.name: Val di Chiana stone casale
listings.headline: 1800s stone casale, 376 m², two units, generous private pool in 6,700 m² garden — €740k
listings.location: Between Lucignano and Monte San Savino
listings.why: The character brief in one house: exposed stone, beams, terracotta vaults, fireplace under a big arch, two internally linked units, sunny private pool in a kept garden. 376 m² at €740k is unusually cheap for habitable Val di Chiana.
listings.note: Opened 28 Aug 2026. Schema Offer €740000. Main house: living, dining, eat-in kitchen, study/bedroom, TV room, laundry, guest bath down; 4 beds + 2 baths up (master suite). Second unit on the ground floor: kitchen, 2 beds, 1 bath. Garage + technical annex. Year listed 1800.

listings.name: Binibeca garden chalet
listings.headline: White house with arched loggia, private pool and 1,000 m², five minutes’ walk to Binibeca beach — cut from €795k
listings.why: On-page cut 795 → 745. Green shutters, arched porch, built pool, distant sea, walk to the cove. Not the €1.2M Binibeca design villa already on the board.
listings.note: Title “Comprar:”. Two baths for four bedrooms. Year not printed. More traditional Menorcan than new architecture.

listings.name: Campos renovated patio-pool townhouse
listings.headline: 1957 townhouse renovated 2020, private patio pool, garage — €750k
listings.why: Old bones, 2020 redo: open kitchen, master en-suite, garage, and a private patio with a small pool in Campos centre. Walk to market; Es Trenc ~15 min. €750k is the top of the bargain band for a real private pool in southeast village stock (board Campos W-04AZ31 sits at €1.2M).
listings.note: Opened 29 Aug 2026. Offer price 750000 EUR; page InStock; status ACTIVE; condition.top. 3 bed / 3 bath / ~230 m² on 160 m². Listing text: 'the small pool offers a welcome respite'. Not W-04AZ31.

listings.name: Colico lake villa
listings.headline: Detached contemporary house, lake-facing pool
listings.why: Flat roof garden, large lake glass, A+++ heat pump, underfloor heat, ceiling cooling.
listings.note: Detached, unlike the Gravedona pair. New-build VAT may apply.

listings.name: Magione stone casale + dependance
listings.headline: Restored stone farmhouse plus two guest apartments, 12×4 private pool — €750k
listings.location: Between San Giovanni del Pantano and Preggio, Magione
listings.why: Pietra, beams, cotto, stone arches; cypress drive; 12×4 pool with solarium. Main casale ~170 m² (3 beds) plus a 3-storey stone dependance split into 50 m² + 100 m² apartments. Furnished and already set up to live or let.
listings.note: Opened 28 Aug 2026. Schema Offer €750000. 6/6, ~320 m², ~5,532 m² land. Irrigation on terraced garden. Hiking country toward Monte Tezio; Antognolla golf ~25 min. Not the board's existing Trasimeno listing (W-02UT2G / €890k).

listings.name: Trullo dei Sogni, Ostuni
listings.headline: 2021 trullo and dependance with a private pool in the Ostuni countryside
listings.why: New trullo fabric, not a ruin. Main house plus dependance, built pool.
listings.note: 150 m² walkable / 240 m² commercial. Different from the other Ostuni houses.

listings.name: Coves Noves chalet
listings.headline: Three-bedroom Coves Noves house with garden and private pool
listings.why: Live Ses Moreres stock with a built pool.
listings.note: Urbanización, not a stone finca. Sqm not on the page.

listings.name: Villa Majorelle, Siracusa
listings.headline: Sea-access villa with an 18×10 m private pool and tennis court
listings.why: Oversized built pool, pine garden, sea access. Local Sicilian desk.
listings.note: Two baths for three bedrooms. Contemporary, not stone.

listings.name: Diano hill villa
listings.headline: Modern-minimalist house above the Ligurian sea
listings.why: Industrial detailing, sculptural concrete spiral stair, floor-to-ceiling glass, 14.4 kW PV plus battery.
listings.note: No pool. Compensation is the architecture, olives, and the terrace.

listings.name: Villa Elysia
listings.headline: Contemporary house with an architect-integrated indoor pool, 12 km from L’Aquila
listings.why: Big contemporary volume in inland Abruzzo: glazing, wooden floors, pool built into the portico, wellness below.
listings.note: Casaitalia asks €780k. Quadrifoglio / Casa.it show the same house at €720k. Confirm the number. Indoor pool.

listings.name: Ostuni villa + ancient lamia
listings.headline: 2022 local-style new villa paired with an ancient lamia, private pool in olive countryside
listings.why: Exact Luce old-and-new brief: new 2022 villa in local style plus ancient lamia, fruit trees, built pool and outdoor kitchen on 8,500 m².
listings.note: Schema Offer €780000. Two distinct volumes. Title on E&V: Villa di charme con lamia antica.

listings.name: Villaggio Inchiuso villa
listings.headline: Single-level 2018 house with an 11.5×5 pool, five ensuites, A1, Etna hills
listings.why: Sicily outside Noto–Avola–Siracusa. Contemporary, large glass, A1, existing pool.
listings.note: Agency notes August 2026 contact by email only.

listings.name: Noto Meti infinity villa
listings.headline: Saltwater infinity pool, dry-stone walls, 3 suites on 6,000 m² near Noto — €790k
listings.why: Design-forward but grounded: dry-stone walls, sliding glass to the veranda, saltwater infinity pool and outdoor kitchen on 6,000 m². Energy A+. Already rented, so it is habitable now — not a wreck and not the board’s Falconara €650k.
listings.note: Opened 29 Aug 2026. Schema Offer €790000. 3 bed / 4 bath / ~240 m² / ~6,000 m². Living + guest bath upstairs; three bedrooms each with a bath and independent outdoor access below. PV + borehole. Different from House&Villas Meti 1272 (€870k, 2 bed) which was held.

listings.name: Ostuni villa + trullo
listings.headline: New contemporary house with restored trullo and pool
listings.why: Recent contemporary volume plus an independent restored trullo, pool between the two, resin floors, underfloor heat, energy class A.
listings.note: Guest house is the trullo. Works as a home or a small rental.

listings.name: Mahón Cos de Gràcia townhouse
listings.headline: Historic-centre 4-bed townhouse on Cos de Gràcia, private garden and pool — €795k
listings.why: Old-and-new in town: period street, private garden + pool (rare in Mahón centro), three floors plus attic, several terraces. Character over sleek contemporary.
listings.note: Opened 29 Aug 2026. Asking 795.000 €. 4 bed / 2 bath / Pool / AC / Garden / 242 m² / 348 m². Principal suite + kitchen to garden terrace on one floor; two doubles + bath + terrace up; attic as 4th bedroom with its own terrace. Not E&V W-04A6UG (different Mahón historic house, 1886, 5/3, 327 m², €985k).

listings.name: Sant Lluís sea-view chalet
listings.headline: Renovated 122 m² chalet on 1,200 m² with a private pool, south coast
listings.why: Tasteful renovation, three doubles, private pool, sea views.
listings.note: Bath count not printed on the page.

listings.name: Pietralunga stone casale with pool
listings.headline: 1900s exposed-stone farmhouse, 5 ensuite beds, panoramic private pool — €795k
listings.why: The character brief in one house: exposed stone, wooden beams, terracotta, stone fireplace, and a built panoramic pool in the woods 12 minutes from Umbertide. Two independent units, five ensuite bedrooms, habitable now.
listings.note: Opened 29 Aug 2026. Schema Offer €795000. 5 bed / 5 bath / ~250 m² / ~7,000 m². Ground: kitchen with stone walls, living with stone fireplace, three ensuite doubles, terrace to the pool. Upper independent unit: living, kitchen, two ensuite beds, roof terrace. Features include Swimming pool. Energy F. Municipality Pietralunga, services in Umbertide (12 km).

listings.name: Le Balze villa
listings.headline: Move-in Valdarno villa with pool, 10 kW solar, and two outbuildings
listings.why: Inland Tuscany against the Balze cliffs, not Versilia. Pool, AC, parquet, published 10 kW PV, and two outbuildings on 3,649 sqm.
listings.note: Energy class G. Fact sheet is 221 sqm; some text says ~250. Florence about 40 minutes.

listings.name: Casale Suki
listings.headline: Restored stone-and-brick casale 3 km from Panicale, 16×8 saltwater pool, 570 olives
listings.pool: Private 16×8 m saltwater infinity pool plus hydromassage, south solarium
listings.why: The real Panicale house on this hunt: exposed stone and brick, 2008 redo still in excellent order, a serious 16×8 salt pool, 2.2 ha and 570 producing olives. Habitable now, not a project.
listings.note: Agency page today: 800.000€, 316 mq, 3 beds / 4 baths, garden 22,420 mq. English sister page same specs. Energy class 'being defined'. Attico.it mirror updated 7 Aug 2026 at the same price. 100 m easy dirt drive. Not on the Luce board.

listings.name: Ciutadella marès house
listings.headline: Historic Ciutadella house, marès vaults, finished interiors, private patio pool
listings.why: The brief: old fabric, new interiors, vaulted marès, and a real private pool by the cathedral.
listings.note: Parking is a nearby plaza, not on plot.

listings.name: Maria de la Salut townhouse
listings.headline: 2025 contemporary renovation with a private patio pool
listings.why: Minimalist 2025 redo: open living, large glass to a private patio pool, steel stair, marès, heat pump. Sold furnished.
listings.note: Inland Pla. Parking for one car.

listings.name: S’Estanyol rowhouse
listings.headline: 2025 contemporary terrace house, private pool, sea-view rooftop, furnished
listings.why: Move-in 2025 terrace house with a private pool (not communal) and a rooftop looking at the sea. Different house from the €1.165M S’Estanyol villa already on the board.
listings.note: Rowhouse, not detached. Small 120 sqm plot. Energy class D.

listings.name: Andora infinity villa
listings.headline: Hillside Andora house with an infinity pool fused to the sea horizon
listings.why: Liguria outside Diano. Existing infinity pool and sea view, plus an independent dependance. Five minutes from the water.
listings.note: Only two bathrooms for four bedrooms. Compact 350 sqm plot. Energy class C.

listings.name: Oleggio Castello A4
listings.headline: 2022 A4 villa, Boffi kitchen, heated pool with beach entry — Maggiore hinterland
listings.why: New-build contemporary house on Maggiore, the under-covered lake. Designer kitchen, A4, heat pump, 6 kW PV, heated pool.
listings.note: Card lists 2 bedrooms; copy mentions a further room upstairs. Energy 14.96 kWh/m²a.

listings.name: Casale two units, Panicale
listings.headline: Part-stone renovated casale, private pool, no white road, two independent flats
listings.pool: Private pool with sunbathing / relaxation area
listings.why: Ready, paved access, living room window on a built private pool, part-stone, fireplace, two units that can stay split for guests or income. Proper Panicale, not a lake-north substitute.
listings.note: E&V JSON-LD Offer €850000, datePosted 2025-09-30. 9 rooms / 5 beds / 3 baths / ~290 m² / ~6,500 m², year 1995, energy C. Ground floor 3 beds + living onto the pool; first floor 2 beds, second living, panoramic terrace. A/C, well + municipal water, carport for 3.

listings.name: Villa Serena
listings.headline: Single-level contemporary house with a 10×4 infinity pool
listings.why: Vaulted contemporary plan, rooftop terrace, Starlink, and an infinity pool on a hectare of land.
listings.note: Different house from the Premier Ostuni listing already on the board.

listings.name: Villa V
listings.headline: Architect house on 1.8 hectares of olive and almond
listings.location: Contrada Grattile, San Vito dei Normanni
listings.why: Explicitly architect-designed contemporary villa, A4, PV, landscaped outdoor kitchen and fire pit.
listings.note: One of the best land-to-price ratios on the board.

listings.name: Felanitx townhouse
listings.headline: 2024 restoration with a garden pool, lift, and five en-suite bedrooms
listings.why: 2024 restoration: historic beams, modern interiors, lift to all floors, all bedrooms en suite, private pool in the garden. Energy class B.
listings.note: Town-centre house, not a coastal villa. Airport about 40 minutes.

listings.name: Oviglio pool villa
listings.headline: Gas-free A1 house on 1 ha with a 15×6 m pool and guest annex
listings.why: Piedmont is thin on the board. Move-in villa with a serious pool, annex, 15 kW PV, and no gas. Different town from Morsasco.
listings.note: Portico comfort more than cubist design. Energy class A1. Garage for four cars. Wooden building for two horses.

listings.name: Cisternino panoramic trullo
listings.headline: Finely restored trullo, private panoramic pool, 3 beds on a quiet Cisternino contrada
listings.why: Character trullo redo that kept the cones, contemporary comfort, built panoramic pool — ready, not a shell.
listings.note: Schema Offer €870000. Distinct from board cisternino-trullo (Ostuni Domus rif 16 at €645k).

listings.name: Mancor olive-mill house
listings.headline: 1810 tafona, 2024 designer renovation, heat pump, private terrace pool by the church
listings.why: Old-and-new done properly: historic olive mill, 2024 electrical/plumbing/heat-pump redo, open designer kitchen, stone terrace pool looking at the village church. A 2024 design house at an inland price, not a southwest premium.
listings.note: Card 143 m²; copy also says ~158 m² plus a historic outbuilding (studio / guest / office) with its own bath. Energy class C. Some gallery images are PNG.

listings.name: Ostuni panoramic trulli
listings.headline: Restored trulli, valley-facing private pool, 1.7 ha near Cisternino — €875k
listings.why: Vaulted living, original chianche, recovered-wood loft, traditional kitchen, pool aimed at the valley, pergola and masonry seats. Heat-pump A/C, CCTV, Starlink. Ready main house; extra volume to restore is optional, not required.
listings.note: Opened 28 Aug 2026. Schema Offer €875000. Official 2 beds (living room can be a third) / 2 baths / ~269 m² / ~17,300 m². Page is clear there is a further unrestored volume + ~150 m² extra build rights — main nucleo is the habitable bit.

listings.name: Son Remei renovated villa
listings.headline: Single-storey renovated villa, new kitchen, private pool, tourist licence
listings.why: Finished one-level house, three baths, built pool, sea view.
listings.note: Different from Son Ganxo already on the board.

listings.name: Son Bou hillside villa
listings.headline: 4-bed hill villa, private pool, sea and field views in San Jaime — €875k
listings.why: Elevated two-storey house with pool opening to sea and campo views, covered terrace, A/C throughout. Character of a lived-in south-coast villa rather than a white-box newbuild. Different from the board's existing son-bou at €1.2M.
listings.note: Opened 28 Aug 2026. Schema Offer €875000. Main floor: living, kitchen, 2 beds, 2 baths + terrace to pool. Upper: 2 further doubles, 1 bath, big view terrace. 2 outdoor parking. Year 1993.

listings.name: Son Ganxo villa
listings.headline: Refurbished one-level house with pool, distant sea, and a tourist licence
listings.why: Quality refurb, open living to the garden, valid tourist licence, and a drawn annex project. Cleanest turnkey plus income house under €900k.
listings.note: Distant sea, not front-line. More elegant Mediterranean than raw contemporary.

listings.name: Arezzo hill villa
listings.headline: 1993 single-level villa above Arezzo, 4×8 pool with city views, guest apartment below
listings.pool: Private 4×8 m pool with Roman steps
listings.why: Ready Tuscany with a real private pool and view — main floor plus lower guest unit and taverna — under €900k near Arezzo.
listings.note: Schema Offer €880000. Energy class G. Marble/olive-wood floors; pellet heating. Not a stone casale — more comfortable 90s villa with panorama.

listings.name: Ostuni–Cisternino infinity villa
listings.headline: 3 ensuite beds, 40 m² infinity pool, hectare of olives and oranges — €880k
listings.why: Design-forward outdoor life: 40 m² infinity pool aimed at the Itria countryside, three ensuite bedrooms, olives + orange grove. Published July 2026, ottime condizioni — habitable, not a shell.
listings.note: Opened 28 Aug 2026. Internal rif 25007 / agency 11530. Energy G. Page offers the *possibility* of a future dependance — that is optional, pool and house are built. Interior only ~120 m².

listings.name: Ciutadella vaulted townhouse
listings.headline: Old-and-new Ciutadella house with vaulted kitchen and rooftop terrace
listings.why: Character fabric kept, modern fit-out, rooftop over the old town.
listings.note: No pool. Local Ciutadella boutique.

listings.name: Vigodarzere glass villa
listings.headline: Amaranto Architecture house: 18 m glass wall, 10×5 pool, A4 and Tesla Powerwall
listings.why: Strongest architect listing today. Named studio, 18-metre sliding glass, landscape garden, real pool. Veneto is new on the board.
listings.note: 11.4 kW PV plus 14 kW Tesla Powerwall. Energy 36.94 kWh/m²a.

listings.name: Cala Llonga villa
listings.headline: 2022 art-deco house with an infinity pool over Mahón harbour
listings.why: Recently finished hillside villa with solar, harbour views, and an infinity terrace over Port Mahón.
listings.note: Strongest modern design on this first Menorca pass.

listings.name: Cisternino trullo redo 2024
listings.headline: 2024 single-level renovation: open living to pool, Trani stone, shower inside the trullo
listings.why: Fresh 2024 old-and-new: contemporary single level with a real trullo moment in the master shower, garden pool, easy outdoor continuity.
listings.note: Schema Offer €890000. EN page: renovation completed 2024. Simple low-maintenance garden.

listings.name: Valle d’Itria villa
listings.headline: 2024 house with indoor and outdoor heated pools
listings.why: Finished 2024 contemporary: large glass, custom joinery, home automation, dual heated pools.
listings.note: Strongest turnkey design-luxury buy in this sweep.

listings.name: Llubí garden townhouse
listings.headline: 1900 village house, 2017 restore, two ensuites, 677 m² garden and a private pool
listings.why: A real garden, not a patio slot: 677 m² in the village, restored 1900 house, master terrace over the pool. Inland Mallorca volume that the 2025 design redos at this price do not give you.
listings.note: Only two bedrooms. Gas heating. Energy class D. Different house from the Reserved €695k Llubí plunge-pool redo.

listings.name: Noto Contrada Niura
listings.headline: 2020 single-level villa with a 2025 panoramic pool
listings.why: Recent architecture on a hectare above Noto, with PV and a pool finished last year.
listings.note: Same Sicily pocket as Avola, different house. Compact interior.

listings.name: Casale PAC3508, Paciano
listings.headline: 1700 stone casale, 2024 plant and pool redo, 13×3.9 m private pool, 1.6 ha olives
listings.pool: Private 13×3.90 m pool, Roman step, paved sundeck (redone 2024)
listings.why: Paciano is the next hill south-west of Panicale. 1700 stone, guest apartment, 2024 pool and plant work already done, 3 kW PV and EV charger. Character house, not a wreck.
listings.note: Agency page today: Prezzo 890.000 Euro. 396 mq plus 60 mq annexes, 4 beds / 3 baths (main 3 + guest 1), energy G, 900 m white road, artesian well is a right of use not owned. IHS mirror updated 26 June 2026 at the same €890,000.

listings.name: Santa Ana harbour-view house
listings.headline: Spacious Santa Ana house + independent annex, private pool, Mahón harbour views — cut to €890k
listings.why: Visible asking cut €980k → €890k, private pool, guest annex (2 beds), harbour panorama near Cales Fonts — lots of house for the number.
listings.note: Beds = main 5 + annex 2. Built 346 m² on 824 m² plot. Contemporary layout, not dry-stone Menorquín.

listings.name: Trasimeno lake villa
listings.headline: 2022-renovated two-unit house above Passignano with a 6×12 panoramic pool
listings.why: Umbria lake, not Foligno and not Como/Garda. 2022 renovation, heat pumps, solar plus batteries, 150 olive trees, full-size pool.
listings.note: Country house split into a main house and a second apartment, not glass-and-steel design. Energy class G.

listings.name: Zogno new-build
listings.headline: 2023 A4 villa in Val Brembana with a salt pool
listings.why: Finished 2023 house with A4 fabric, PV plus battery, custom furniture, and a salt pool.
listings.note: Only two dedicated bedrooms. Commercial sqm includes a large garage.

listings.name: Cala Llonga new-build
listings.headline: New 4-bed villa with a 9×3.5 m infinity pool on Maó harbour
listings.why: Larger new-build counterpart to the 2022 Cala Llonga house: four bedrooms, bigger infinity pool, floor-to-ceiling glass.
listings.note: Not the same house as the €890k E&V listing. Unfurnished. Airport about 4 km.

listings.name: Cala Murada villa
listings.headline: 2020 clean-architecture house, winter garden, salt pool, solar and EV charger
listings.why: Contemporary detached house a few minutes from the beach. Open living, winter garden with a louvered roof, outdoor kitchen, solar with storage, EV charging. Private pool already built.
listings.note: Strongest ready design house on this Mallorca pass. Energy class C. Vall d’Or golf about 10 km.

listings.name: Muro Bali-style house
listings.headline: 2025 south-facing village house with marès, designer kitchen, waterfall pool
listings.why: Different house from the courtyard one. Marès, polished cement, olive-green kitchen, south terrace, heat pump. Boutique 13 sqm pool.
listings.note: Compact 176 sqm plot. Energy class B. Garage.

listings.name: Muro courtyard house
listings.headline: 2025 designer renovation: four en-suite bedrooms around a private courtyard pool
listings.why: Turnkey 2025 redo: open-plan ground floor, four bedrooms each with its own bath, underfloor heating, BBQ, off-street parking. Ten minutes to Playa de Muro.
listings.note: Townhouse, not a detached villa. Energy class C.

listings.name: Port d’Addaia villa
listings.headline: 2008 high-spec 4-bed house with north-coast sea views, pool and tourist licence
listings.why: High-quality 2008 build: marble stair, heat pump, large glazed terraces for light and sea, private pool on a pine-backed plot.
listings.note: Tourist licence. Energy class D. Garage. Four bedrooms on the lower level.

listings.name: Villa Alghero
listings.headline: West-coast Sardinia villa with pool and a guest house
listings.why: Five en-suite bedrooms, garden pool, and an independent guest house a few minutes from Alghero.
listings.note: Different coast from Villa Mari in San Teodoro. Plot size is not published.

listings.name: Ànima de Marés, Fornells
listings.headline: New-build silent-luxury house with a private pool over Fornells Bay
listings.why: Only current new design project on the north coast under the cap. Local marès stone, private pool, bay outlook.
listings.note: Semi-detached townhouse in a 22-home gated scheme, not a standalone finca. Some units listed at €1.05M.

listings.name: Trulli and stone casale, Ostuni
listings.headline: Authentic trulli plus a stone farmhouse, built pool among olives, between Ostuni and Ceglie
listings.why: Five ensuite-style bedrooms, 384 m², 1.64 ha, built stone pool. Different house from the Ostuni trullo, 2024 contemporary, pietra and Trullo dei Sogni already on the board. Posted 10 Aug 2026.
listings.note: E&V statusNormalized ACTIVE, JSON-LD Offer €900000. hasSwimmingPool true. Some aerials on the page are labelled AI-generated; ground-level pool stills are real. Year not printed.

listings.name: Cala Blanca villa
listings.headline: 5-bed contemporary-Mediterranean house on 1,379 sqm with pool and tourist licence
listings.why: Size and land at this price: renovated kitchen opening to terrace, garden and pool, five minutes west of Ciutadella.
listings.note: More Mediterranean than cubist. Tourist licence. Also seen on E&V at €884k.

listings.name: Cala Llonga new villa
listings.headline: Contemporary hillside new-build with a pool terrace and harbour views
listings.why: Stacked white volumes above Mahón harbour, dark-framed glass, pool on a mid-level terrace. A third Cala Llonga house, not the €890k or €895k ones already on the board.
listings.note: Finished new-build, not CGI. Open living to the pool terrace. Two-car garage at street level.

listings.name: Valmarana villa
listings.headline: 2011 modern house, clean lines and large glazing, pool on the Vicenza hills — now €920k
listings.why: Contemporary white volume, large glass, real pool, garage for four. Vicenza hills, not the lakes.
listings.note: Plot size not published. Excellent condition. Price cut 30 Aug 2026: was €1.1M, now €920k (E&V Offer.price).

listings.name: Punta Grossa villa
listings.headline: 2023–2026 renovation: salt pool, guest annex, tourist licence, 100 m from the sea
listings.why: Complete recent renovation, not a fixer. New salt pool, guest annex, chill terraces, 100 m from the water.
listings.note: 1980 fabric under the redo. Energy class D. Tourist licence.

listings.name: Villa Anima
listings.headline: Single-storey white villa near Torre Guaceto
listings.why: Ground-floor contemporary plan, two verandas, home automation, 15 minutes from Brindisi airport.
listings.note: Only two bedrooms. Very close to town and the reserve beaches.

listings.name: Ostuni overflow villa
listings.headline: Tufo, lime, and a 40 sqm overflow pool
listings.why: Rural fabric recast with contemporary tech: 6 kW PV, batteries, Starlink, overflow pool as the outdoor room.
listings.note: More quiet luxury than showpiece architecture.

listings.name: Puerto Alcúdia villa
listings.headline: 2023 minimalist house, five minutes’ walk from the beach, private pool and rooftop
listings.why: Completed 2023 new-build with clean lines, open living, all bedrooms on one level, rooftop solarium. North-east, not southwest.
listings.note: Compact 314 sqm plot in a tourist-adjacent pocket. Energy class C. Two baths for three beds.

listings.name: Ciutadella beach villa
listings.headline: Mediterranean villa a few metres from the beach, walking to town
listings.why: Three-level house with terrace pool, heat-pump AC, and the beach a short walk from Ciutadella.
listings.note: 2007 build, recently updated systems.

listings.name: La Argentina, Alaior
listings.headline: Big Mediterranean family house with pool on 3,000 sqm
listings.why: Space and land: 552 sqm, four-car garage, quiet cul-de-sac, pool in a flowered garden.
listings.note: 1999 Mediterranean, not new architecture. Energy class F.

listings.name: Anzio designer villa
listings.headline: 2020 Christie's house with a sail-shaped plan
listings.why: Purpose-designed 2020 house: rounded sail volumes, wave stair, full-height glass, full home automation.
listings.note: About an hour from Rome. Pool is an approved project, not in the ground.

listings.name: Sineu 1890 renovated townhouse with pool
listings.headline: 1890 townhouse renovated 2018, stone floors, fireplace, private pool + garage — €985k
listings.agency: Engel & Völkers Santa Maria / EV Mallorca
listings.why: Old-and-new Pla village jewel: 1890 bones, 2018 redo, stone floors, pellet fireplace, ducted A/C, patio garden and swimming pool, private garage. Ready in Sineu centre — character brief met without being sleek-only new-build.
listings.note: Opened 30 Aug 2026. Offer 985000 EUR; page InStock; energy C. 3 bed / 3 bath / 209 m² on 158 m². Not the board's sineu-stone 1466 (€650k country). Village pool stock above the ~€800k bargain line — bargain false.

listings.name: Biniparrell country house
listings.headline: Traditional Menorquín campo redo, private pool, porch to the water, near Mahón / Sant Lluís
listings.why: Charming traditional Menorca with modern comforts: cast-iron fireplace, A/C throughout, porch overlooking a built private pool — not a fixer.
listings.note: Shared well water (typical rural Menorca). Two floors: 1 bed down, 2 up. Live at €990000.

listings.name: Cap d’Artrutx seafront
listings.headline: Renovated 3-bed seafront house, contemporary kitchen, pool aimed at the lighthouse
listings.why: Seafront plot with the pool aimed at the Cap d’Artrutx horizon. Full renovation: contemporary kitchen, modern baths, large glazing to a covered porch.
listings.note: Compact interior (90 sqm) on 500 sqm. Also E&V W-047BW0. Energy class D.

listings.name: S'Uestrà Menorcan campo
listings.headline: Traditional Menorcan country house, guest annexe, large pool, near Sant Lluís
listings.why: Traditional design done well. Year-round family house with an annexe and a real pool.
listings.note: Suburban-rural, not isolated. Glimpse of La Mola, not seafront.

listings.name: Biniali natural-stone finca with saltwater pool
listings.headline: Open stone walls + beams, bodega, saltwater pool, olive patio — €990k
listings.agency: Engel & Völkers Santa Maria / EV Mallorca
listings.why: Design-forward character: open stone walls, exposed beams, high ceilings, Mallorcan kitchen into living, saltwater pool in olive patio, impressive bodega. Easy-maintenance finca scale (1,252 m²) minutes from Biniali — old mixed with new.
listings.note: Opened 30 Aug 2026. Offer 990000 EUR; page InStock. 4 bed / 3 bath / 194 m²; last restoration 2015; oil heating + A/C + private well. NOT the board's biniali W-02SC8C (€1.195M ready townhouse).

listings.name: Ciutadella chill-out house
listings.headline: Renovated 1900 townhouse with teak patio, private pool and marès interiors
listings.why: Designer renovation in the casco: teak patio, private pool, retractable awning, marès stone, beams, skylights. Not the beach villa already on the board.
listings.note: Three floors. Walkable old town. A private pool in the casco is rare.

listings.name: Ostuni modern villa + lamia
listings.headline: Stone lamia and a contemporary two-level villa, pool and pergolas, 8,000 m²
listings.why: Old-and-new on one plot: independent stone lamia (living, masonry kitchen, two beds, two baths) plus a modern villa with an open piano nobile and a master suite. 410 m² and a built pool for under a million in Ostuni countryside.
listings.note: E&V statusNormalized ACTIVE, JSON-LD Offer €995000. Posted 1 Jul 2026. Year not printed. Not the same as ostuni-trullo, ostuni-2024, ostuni-pietra or Villa Serena.

listings.name: Santanyí salt-pool townhouse
listings.headline: 1920 / 2017 redo: beams, natural stone, private ~20 m² saltwater pool in central Santanyí
listings.why: Mallorca village character on-brief: wooden beams, stone, fireplace, roof terrace over the palms, and a real private salt pool — walk to market and cafés.
listings.note: Compact 106 m² / 2 beds. E&V ID W-02X9XE, price 995000 EUR on page today. Energy class E.

listings.name: Es Castell campo with licence
listings.headline: Authentic 313 m² finca, guest annexe, pool, tourist licence
listings.location: Between Sant Lluís and Es Castell
listings.why: Original features kept, two fireplaces, annexe, built pool, existing tourist licence.
listings.note: Older ref, long on market. Confirm how deep the reform went.

listings.name: Alcaufar 1930 Menorcan house with pool
listings.headline: 1930 Menorcan house with soul, private pool, BBQ and sea views in Alcaufar — €995k
listings.why: Character first: 1930 Menorcan fabric, terraces, private pool and BBQ, sea/lake view. Old mixed with liveable now — not sleek-only contemporary.
listings.note: Opened 30 Aug 2026. Offer.price €995000. 3/2 / ~150 m² / ~378 m² / year 1930. Features: balcony, garden, patio, sea view, swimming pool, terrace, furnished. Condition good. Different house from board ses-alcaufar-5501 (Ses Moreres 5501, 115 m², same €995k band) — do not treat as syndicate twin without a visit. i18n watchlist text ignored.

listings.name: Petra townhouse
listings.headline: 2025 high-end redo with a private garden-pool oasis in the village centre
listings.why: Walk-to-square Petra house with a private garden-pool oasis, gourmet kitchen, premium finishes. Optional six-car garage.
listings.note: Energy class D. Furnished optionally.

listings.name: Biniali traditional menorquina
listings.headline: Island-stone menorquina, 4 beds, private pool in the Sant Lluís triangle — €1.05M
listings.why: The cozy-character brief on Menorca: typical island materials, two suites, distant sea view, kept garden, garden casita, built pool. Under 2 km from Sant Lluís. Pellets + A/C + solar. Not a wreck.
listings.note: Opened 28 Aug 2026. Page €1.050.000. 4 bed / 3 bath / 290 m² / 1,491 m². Documentation in order; permits already in place if later works wanted. EN title on the live page: Charming Cottage in the Magical Triangle of Sant Lluís.

listings.name: Sa Rápita 2023 villa
listings.headline: Single-level contemporary house with a private pool on 812 sqm
listings.why: Detached 2023 new-build, not the 2025 VYF 1480 already on the board. Larger plot, single level, open living, principal en-suite.
listings.note: Unfurnished. Energy class C. Garage for one.

listings.name: Sa Rápita new-build
listings.headline: Completed 2025 single-level villa, three en-suites, swim pool on 778 sqm
listings.why: 2025 new-build, single level, three full en-suites, open living to the garden, heat-pump AC. Private pool already built, not a project.
listings.note: Es Trenc / Ses Covetes nearby. Airport about 30 minutes. Ten-year structural guarantee stated.

listings.name: Cala Mandia villa
listings.headline: 2022 detached family house, saltwater pool, five-minute walk to the beach
listings.why: Recent detached house with aerothermal underfloor heating, solar for hot water, roof terrace, and a private saltwater pool. Walk to Cala Mandia.
listings.note: Listed as furnished. Palma airport about 50 minutes.

listings.name: Cala en Porter cliff villa
listings.headline: Completely remodelled contemporary house on the cliff, designer kitchen, panoramic terraces, tourist licence
listings.why: Only new contemporary-plus-pool house on Menorca today that was not already on the board. Cliff over the cove, interiors to panoramic terraces, tourist licence. Reduced from €1.2M.
listings.note: Bonnin lists 69 sqm constructed for a 3-bed two-level house. Confirm that figure with the agency. Location is the story.

listings.name: Ostuni seven-cone trulli with annex and saltwater pool
listings.headline: Seven-cone trullo + lamia + independent annex, stone kitchen, saltwater pool, 2.3 ha olives — €1.1M
listings.why: Yesterday’s held overflow, still live: seven-cone trullo and lamia plus a guest trullo, traditional stone kitchen, cone ceilings, dry-stone olives and a built saltwater pool. Habitable now — the Valle d’Itria character brief at scale.
listings.note: Opened 30 Aug 2026 (held 29 Aug for mix; still €1,100,000 ACTIVE). 4 bed / 4 bath / 360 m² / 23,000 m². ~200 olives, artesian well, PV, alarm. Body confirms saltwater pool + BBQ patio. Not ostuni-trulli-casale W-0473JR or ceglie-masseria W-02ZRFB. Not a bargain at €1.1M.

listings.name: Binidalí contemporary
listings.headline: Single-level house with pool to distant sea, a walk from the cove
listings.why: Quiet one-level plan in a private cove. Master suite opens to the pool, roof terrace to the sea, walk to Cala Binidalí.
listings.note: 1994 fabric with renovation potential. Not a 2020s new-build.

listings.name: Cala’n Blanes seafront
listings.headline: Contemporary seafront villa with open kitchen, pool terrace and a master sea-view suite
listings.why: Minimalist white villa, floor-to-ceiling glass to a stone pool terrace, unobstructed sea. Master suite upstairs with its own terrace.
listings.note: Listed as available and furnished. Energy certificate yes.

listings.name: Casale Hermosa
listings.headline: Fully renovated stone house, 6×12 m pool, 13 ha including olives
listings.why: Historic stone, finished interiors, guest apartment, built 6×12 pool.
listings.note: Cover photo is a location panorama. Ask KNT for house stills.

listings.name: Sale Marasino lake villa
listings.headline: 2017 contemporary house on Lake Iseo, furnished, with pool
listings.why: Move-in ready lakeside house with floor-to-ceiling glass, home automation, PV, and furnishings included. A different lake from Como and Garda.
listings.note: Energy class A+. Do not confuse with a nearby new-build over €1.2M.

listings.name: Puig de Ros house
listings.headline: 2023 new-build with saltwater pool, sea-view rooftop, heat pump
listings.why: Contemporary 2023 build: open living, two upstairs en suites, rooftop with sea views, saltwater pool, underfloor heating, energy class B.
listings.note: Semi-detached, not detached. Some photos are virtually staged. No garage.

listings.name: Sierra Morena stone finca
listings.headline: Restored exposed-stone house in 1 ha of woodland, pool and stone guest cottage
listings.pool: Large private pool, solarium and BBQ
listings.why: The brief: exposed stone, old threshing floor, restored guest cottage, woodland, built pool.
listings.note: Near the cap. Modest 188 m² main house. Rural-nucleus rules for any extension.

listings.name: S’Estanyol villa
listings.headline: Detached south-coast house: three en-suites, pool, sauna, photovoltaic
listings.why: Detached, all three doubles en suite, open kitchen island, pool, garage sauna, PV. Borders undevelopable green space. Energy class B.
listings.note: Construction year not printed on the page. Es Trenc a short drive.

listings.name: Ses Salines courtyard house
listings.headline: 2025 village house with a courtyard pool and rooftop
listings.why: Designed-from-scratch contemporary house in the village core: courtyard pool, two en-suites, 25 sqm rooftop.
listings.note: Compact. Two bedrooms only. Some gallery images are renders. Energy cert in progress.

listings.name: Torret de Baix villa
listings.headline: Infinity pool to the horizon, rooftop solarium, 1,400 sqm on the south coast
listings.why: Strongest infinity-pool plus sea-view composition under the cap. Every main room opens to garden and pool.
listings.note: Also with HSH as HSH-ME 00685. Plot has legal headroom to expand.

listings.name: Betlem house, Artà
listings.headline: 2024 renovation with private pool, PV, and an extra plot plus garage in the price
listings.why: Detached house with an existing pool. 2022–2024 reno: open kitchen island, underfloor heating, heat pump, PV. Extra adjoining plot and double garage included.
listings.note: Traditional Mallorcan fabric, updated interiors. Quiet fishing-village setting. Bath count on the card is 2.

listings.name: Biniali town house
listings.headline: 2023 new-build with a private pool, three en-suites, modern Mallorcan
listings.why: New construction to a high standard: open living to terrace and pool, three first-floor en-suites, heat pump, garage. Energy class B.
listings.note: Modest 205 sqm plot. Pool is private, not communal.

listings.name: Sa Pobla 1890 townhouse
listings.headline: 1890 Mallorcan townhouse restored 2025, garden pool and guest house
listings.why: 1890 fabric, 2025 restore: island kitchen, sliding glass, PV, built pool, one-bed guest house.
listings.note: Village centre on 437 m², not a finca. Seven bedrooms. About 14 km to the coast.

listings.name: Trebalúger renovated villa
listings.headline: Open-plan glass living to porches and pool on 830 sqm
listings.why: Full renovation with sliding glass to the pool and a first-floor suite terrace. Most finished contemporary interior inland of Mahón under €1.2M.
listings.note: Quiet residential, not seafront. E&V has a parallel card at the same price, likely the same house.

listings.name: Villa Artemisia
listings.headline: Restored farmhouse estate at the budget cap
listings.why: Full luxury package: park, pool, guest annexe, frescoes, fitness room. Pisa 35 km.
listings.note: Restored farmhouse luxury, not new architecture. Tuscany contemporary under €1.2M is scarce.

listings.name: Avola infinity villa
listings.headline: Black overflow pool on 3 hectares near Noto
listings.why: Single-storey 2026 house: Modica stone, Vietri ceramics, flush doors, black infinity pool.
listings.note: At the cap. Extra unused building volume on the land.

listings.name: Binibeca design villa
listings.headline: 2014 one-level design house, saltwater pool, rooftop sunset terrace
listings.why: Cleanest design villa on the south coast at the cap: one-level plan, island kitchen, rooftop sea-sunset terrace, annex bedroom by the pool.
listings.note: Also on Spain Sotheby's at the same price. About 5 minutes to Binibeca beach.

listings.name: Campos townhouse
listings.headline: 1890 house, fully redesigned 2024: open plan, Moroccan brass, patio pool
listings.why: Designer 2024 renovation: open living with fireplace, underfloor heating, handmade Moroccan brass, private pool in the patio. At the exact cap.
listings.note: Townhouse, not a detached villa. Airport about 25 minutes. Es Trenc a short drive.

listings.name: Chioma sea-view villa
listings.headline: Infinity pool and bioclimatic pergola over the Tuscan Archipelago
listings.why: Independent Etruscan Coast house at the cap: infinity pool to the archipelago, three en-suite bedrooms, outdoor kitchen, last-generation bioclimatic rooftop pergola.
listings.note: 2005 build, energy class F. Not a 2020s new-build. Garden listed as 2,500 sqm (also given as ~1,000).

listings.name: Ciutadella cathedral house
listings.headline: Design-led old-town house: marès patio, private plunge pool, cathedral terrace
listings.why: High-end renovation blending Menorcan fabric with contemporary baths and a private courtyard plunge pool. Terrace looking at the cathedral.
listings.note: At the exact cap. Energy certificate in process. Not the beach villa.

listings.name: Villa Bella Vista, Dolceacqua
listings.headline: Hill house above Dolceacqua, 360° sea-and-Alps views, south pool terrace, 2023 redo
listings.why: Liguria inland, not Diano or Andora. Full-height glass to the pool terrace, steam room, Finnish sauna. At the cap.
listings.note: Energy class E. Extra build right on part of the land. Buyer commission 3.66% incl. VAT.

listings.name: Felanitx historic townhouse
listings.headline: Fully renovated sandstone townhouse, guest apartment, private patio pool — €1.2M
listings.why: Old-and-new at the cap: historic sandstone kept, handmade terracotta, fireplace, inner patio with private pool and BBQ, plus a separate guest apartment. Walk to the plaça. Different from the board's existing Felanitx E&V townhouse.
listings.note: Opened 28 Aug 2026. Live price €1,200,000. Card: 3 bed / 4 bath / 378 m² / 286 m². Body text also says ~370 m², 2 beds + 3 baths in the main house plus guest apt (1 bed / 1 bath) — counted as 3/4. Gas central heating, wood double-glazing. Agency also shows internal 4128-1.

listings.name: Marino park villa
listings.headline: 2023 rebuild with saltwater pool and Rome views
listings.why: Full 2023 reconstruction: herringbone oak, panoramic glass, winter garden, gym, views toward Rome.
listings.note: About 9 km from Rome’s GRA. Biggest interior on the board.

listings.name: Ostuni historic stone house
listings.headline: Ancient stone villa, recently renovated, vaults and contemporary interiors, private pool
listings.pool: Private pool in a Mediterranean garden
listings.why: Stone façade left rustic, interiors redone contemporary. High vaults, original floors, built pool among olives.
listings.note: At the €1.2M cap. Ten minutes from Ostuni centre.

listings.name: Porto Maurizio infinity villa
listings.headline: 180° sea view, 13×4 infinity pool, design stair — Imperia, not Diano or Andora
listings.why: Liguria outside Diano and Andora. Real infinity pool to the sea, 50 olive trees, African walnut and aluminium stair.
listings.note: 2006, at the exact cap. Almost every other contemporary Liguria villa today was over budget.

listings.name: Son Bou sea-view villa
listings.headline: South-facing family house, pool, views from almost every room
listings.why: Best long-beach address at the cap. Living slides to the pool and covered dining. En-suite bedrooms looking south to Son Bou.
listings.note: 2000 build on three levels into the slope. Also Lucas Fox MEN69492. Semi-furnished.
